text: Men Nulaani ado maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, si wanaa worɓe ɓanndinkooɓe, Men wahayina e maɓɓe. Men Nulaali Malaa'ikaaɓe. Ɗum ko sunna Amen woowaaɗo. Si tawiinon on yeddii ɗum, haray lanndee yimɓe Defte adinooɗe ɗen, ɓen humpitay on wonnde Nulaaɓe ɓen ko ɓandinnkooɓe wonunoo, ɓe wonaano Malaa'ika fes, si tawii on anndaa ko ɓe ɓanndinkooɓe.
